scope: Fixed L=16 torus; three complex components in the six-real convention; hash-pinned A1 production symbol and coefficients; rho_regularizer=1e-12; eta_shell=0; exact Fourier products; the unit sharp regulator; and the A10-A12 strict dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The Fierz, phase-null, shell-commutator, active-carrier, and resolvent-limit statements are analytic. The finite polynomial is a large-margin executed cross-route certificate, not a formal floating-point interval proof.

theorem.fierz_matrix: With X=Z+W, s=|Z|^2, R=|X|^2+rho_floor, P=4[s E_Z-(JZ)(JZ)^T], and d=a+2b+c, B(X)=dP-4(b+c)(s/R)(Z tensor X+X tensor Z)+4c(s/R)^2 X tensor X.
theorem.separate_phase_nulls: B(X)JZ=0 and B(X)JW=0; arbitrary local doublet-common and singlet phases contribute no carrier derivative.
theorem.sharp_operator_bound: 0<=B(X)<=beta_op s I and B(X)^2<=beta_op s B(X), beta_op=4(a+2b+c).
theorem.shell_commutator: For u_j=P_<=j-1 phi, P_j[B(u_j)D u_j]=[P_j,M_B(u_j)]D u_j because P_jD u_j=0.
theorem.active_carrier: For opposite doublet momenta, B(X)D_iX=i beta_op(k1_i-k2_i)(X1|X2|^2,-|X1|^2X2,0); the carrier is floor-independent because ds=drho=0.
theorem.corner_limit: For the tensor boundary polynomial, the exact-B source/sextic ratio tends beta_op^2[(D_K/B_K)^3-(C_K/B_K)^3], including both complex components and the q^-4 covariance convention.
theorem.budget_no_go: The explicit K=65536 certificate gives C_rel>0.9>gamma/3=0.54, so C_rel<gamma/(3p) fails for every p>=1.
theorem.resolvent_persistence: On the fixed-envelope carrier ||T_j||=O_K(N^-2), hence (I+pT_j)^-1 tends I and the same lower limit survives.

certificate.independent_method: alias-free physical grid with separate FFT projection

consequence.forbidden_successor: standalone deterministic exact-B source-square absorption, with or without resolvent-only repair

closed: the exact compact Fierz form of B

does_not_rule_out: a probabilistic cancellation not available to deterministic source absorption

not_claimed: unboundedness of the exact source constant
A11 stabilised log-Laplace or A7 Nelson closure

phase transition, BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7
